{c_important}{u}Hex{/u}{/c} stacks up to a maximum of {c_number}{SF_2}{/c}. When a target gains {c_number}{SF_2}{/c} stacks, {c_number}[{SF_3}*100|%|]{/c} of the {c_important}Occult Abyss{/c} Skill damage dealt to the target echoes after {c_number}{SF_4}{/c} seconds and removes all stacks of {c_important}{u}Hex{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}Command Valloch{/c} now causes {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} enemies to take {c_number}[{SF_5}*100|%|]{/c} of the {c_important}Occult Abyss{/c} Skill damage instantly and killing enemies reduces your active {c_important}Occult Abyss{/c} Skill Cooldowns by {c_number}[{SF_8}|1|]{/c} |4second:seconds; while you've siphoned its power.
